parsed.note_claim: Russia has deployed approximately 600,000 troops to Ukraine out of 1.1 million active-duty personnel.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Still, Russia is estimated to have a total of 1.1 million active-duty soldiers , roughly 600,000 of which are deployed in or near Ukraine.
parsed.reason: The page explicitly states the total active-duty soldier count and the number deployed in or near Ukraine, directly substantiating the note's claim.
